# llms.txt — 意識とは / What Is Consciousness

> This file helps AI assistants and language models understand the structure and content of this site.

## Site Overview

This page is one of the explorations behind the reading "Love駆動開発と呼びたいもの" (https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/reader/love-driven-dev.html). It looks at the receiving side: what do people cut the world with?

- **Primary Language**: Japanese (日本語), with English summaries
- **Site URL**: https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/
- **Topics**: Consciousness and awareness, signals of survival and trust, Intersubjectivity
- **Aim**: to become able to say what consciousness (意識) is. Whether it can be told apart from awareness (気づき) is used internally as a test of that aim: without that difference, the outline of the word consciousness stays vague. The page places pjdhiro's first-person experience at its center; research in neurophenomenology and psychology is examined as material for thinking about it.

## Core Concepts

The top page is one continuous reading, in Japanese and English. Each chapter has a short visible part; explanations and sources are folded under "詳しく" (More). All claims are held as tentative views (〜かもしれない), not conclusions.

### Consciousness as a named vortex (意識も、波間に見えた渦の一つ)

Consciousness may be one of the names people gave to a vortex they could cut out at a size easy to perceive. The cause of a vortex is not found by searching inside it; the vortex is continuous with the waves and the sea.

### Signals of survival and trust (生存と信頼の信号)

pjdhiro sees people as possibly cutting the world by anticipating two values: whether they can survive (threat, safety, status, resources) and whether they can stay connected (attachment, belonging, trust, intersubjectivity). The two are written apart for clarity but are not separate; they are mistaken for each other and woven into each other.

An earlier version of this site called trying to solve trust problems through survival achievements "misapplication (誤適用)" and treated it as the core of the hypothesis. It is now read as one example of the two being mistaken for each other.

### Where the contour blurs (一列の記号には、二つの値が乗りきらない)

Words and numbers line up in one row. When a person anticipates two values, a symbol can agree on survival while the trust value stays unknown. The source of that unease is not found on the symbols, and the contour of what was cut out may blur there. The page "欠損駆動思考" (../ks/) looks at the lack felt there.

### Intersubjectivity (間主観性)

Experience and meaning being shared between people. One of the things the trust signal looks at. This page also asks how consciousness arises within relationships between people.

## Important Note

The site is written with AI assistance and may contain errors. pjdhiro's own words are quoted and labeled (体験・見立て・例・問い).

## Site Structure

- `index.html` — Main entry point with visualization (the list of records is rendered by JS)
- `evidence/answers.md` — Questions and answers: for each question on the top page, how the research in the records speaks to it (in Japanese; a draft, with unanswered parts marked as under construction)
- `evidence/evidence-*.md` — Records checked against the original sources (listed below)
- `evidence/reviewed.json` — The list of those records shown on the top page
- `knowledge/raw/manifest.md` — Ledger of the original sources (bibliography and how each was obtained; PDFs are not published)
- Source repository: https://github.com/uminomae/project-design-theory/tree/main/as

## Records checked against the original sources

Research that bears on consciousness and awareness is re-examined area by area by going back to the original papers. Each record sets out what each study established and what it did not, where it was read, and the verification status of each source. The records are in Japanese and are written by Claude (AI); they may contain errors. The top page lists them under "調べてきたこと" (What has been explored).

- [論点と回答：既存の知見はどう言っているか / Questions and answers: what existing research says](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/answers.md) — For each question on the top page, how the research in the records below speaks to it. A draft; parts not yet answered are left marked as under construction
- [神経現象学の方法 / Methods of neurophenomenology](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A01-neurophenomenology-method.md) — How descriptions of experience are gathered and set against neural measures, and how far those descriptions can be trusted
- [予測と気づき / Prediction and awareness](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A02-prediction-and-awareness.md) — How prediction and prediction error relate to what reaches consciousness, and whether predictive processing is a theory of consciousness
- [自己と境界 / Self and its boundaries](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A03-self-and-boundary.md) — How watching one's own mind and the thinning of the sense of self have been described and measured in metacognition and meditation research
- [内受容と情動 / Interoception and emotion](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A04-interoception-and-emotion.md) — How signals from inside the body come to be felt, and whether emotions are built-in circuits or constructed in the moment
- [不確かさと安全 / Uncertainty and safety](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A05-uncertainty-and-safety.md) — Uncertainty, anxiety and stress, and the perception of safety: the view that a stress response is the default and perceived safety inhibits it, and its critics
- [関係と信頼 / Relationships and trust](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A06-relationship-and-trust.md) — Attachment and the secure base, early infant interaction, social regulation, belonging and loneliness: how relationships change the appraisal of threat and bodily cost
- [間主観性の哲学と臨床 / Intersubjectivity in philosophy and the clinic](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A07-intersubjectivity.md) — Whether others' experience is given directly before inference: embodied interaction, infant intersubjectivity, the clinical holding environment, and their critics
- [意識とメタ意識の区別 / Consciousness and meta-awareness](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A08-consciousness-and-meta-awareness.md) — How conscious experience has been told apart from becoming aware of it (meta-awareness, introspection): higher-order theories, the phenomenal/access distinction, and their critics
- [信号の分け方 / Kinds of signals](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A09-signal-kinds.md) — How research has divided defensive reactions from pleasure and displeasure, trust and disgust; whether threats to the body and threats to one's social standing run on separate systems; and whether two kinds are enough
- [間主観性の信号 / Signals between people](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A10-intersubjective-signals.md) — What has been measured as a signal between people; whether synchrony between two brains and bodies makes up the experience of interacting or is a by-product of shared input; recent accounts and their critics
- [安定とつながりの感じ・手放す構え / Stability, connectedness and letting go](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A11-stability-and-letting-go.md) — How a settled sense of stability, equanimity, connectedness and awe in adults has been described and measured; scales for letting go and for the need to reach closure; cases where loosening the boundaries of the self is reported as distress; and critiques of the scales
- [信頼の定義と長い時間の動機 / Defining trust and long-term motives](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A12-trust-definition-and-long-motives.md) — How trust has been defined and measured across fields; research on long-term goals in which a lack of connection is filled by goals of status and money, and which way the link runs; and studies that compare the conflict between connection and self-protection motives
- [一列の記号と、そこに乗らない値 / Symbols and the values they do not carry](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A13-symbols-and-unspoken-values.md) — How far verbal and numerical reports line up with bodily responses and behaviour; how tone of voice and face-to-face contact bear on trust and cooperation; resistance to putting relationship values into money; and hypotheses about where unspoken feelings come from, with their critiques
- [受け取る側の選び方 / How the receiver selects](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A14-selection-by-the-receiver.md) — How attention picks out threat cues and social cues; studies in which value and concern capture attention, and critiques of how reliably these are measured; and what the salience network has been said to pick up
- [取り違えへの気づき / Noticing misattribution](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A15-noticing-misattribution.md) — How far self-reported motives match motives measured through stories; the limits of self-knowledge and noticing within life narratives; and experiments on misattributing the cause of a feeling, with their replications
- [神経系の分かれ方と二つの信号 / Divisions of the nervous system and the two signals](https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/as/evidence/evidence-A16-neural-divisions.md) — Whether any research divides self-protective signals from signals of connection somewhere in the nervous system: the view of the brain as old and new layers and its critics, the cerebellum and emotion, the spinal cord and the heart's nervous system, and the chemical systems of bonding and stress

Earlier versions (three reader guides, a topic page and its slides, and a survey overview) were written before the claims were checked against the original sources. They were withdrawn from this site on 2026-11-10 and are no longer listed here. The image cards of notes from divergent thinking were withdrawn on 2026-11-12.
